name: Monind Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1982, Monnet Industries Ltd manufactures and processes Basic Iron and Steel[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company is a part of Monnet Group which manufactures Ferro Alloys and allied product viz. Ferro Manganese (Fe-Mn), Silico Manganese (Si-Mn) and Ferro Chrome (Fe-Cr). These are supplied in diverse shapes and forms from billets and ingots to powders, fillers and allied reinforcements

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
